form.label: CCDC | MSSQL
form.description: Windows Server 2019 MSSQL at 172.20.240.120. SQL audit/XE panels need additional ingestion.

input.label: Select indexed hostname for this VM

search.query: index=* earliest=-24h | stats count by host | fields host | sort host
index=* host="$selected_host$" EventCode=4624 | stats count by host,Account_Name,Logon_Type,Source_Network_Address | sort -count
index=* host="$selected_host$" (EventCode=7045 OR EventCode=4697 OR EventCode=4698) | table _time EventCode host Message | sort -_time
index=* host="$selected_host$" (sourcetype=mssql:audit OR sourcetype=mssql:xe) ("LOGIN" OR "AUTH") | table _time host login_name client_ip _raw | sort -_time
index=* host="$selected_host$" (sourcetype=mssql:xe OR sourcetype=mssql:audit) ("xp_cmdshell" OR "xp_dirtree" OR "EXECUTE AS") | table _time host login_name sql_text _raw | sort -_time
